case.summary: Transaction 3523199 ($100.07 online on 2016-12-07) was flagged by the bank's model at risk score 0.54. The device profile is new to the account (iOS Device, marked New), and it is shared with account C03714. The graph showed 8 structurally similar closed cases retrieved by shared device and billing region, all 8 confirmed as fraud, predominantly account takeover and card-not-present patterns with exposures ranging from $99.99 to $6539.73. The customer account itself has 3 prior confirmed-fraud cases on record, all account takeover incidents. However, the assessed fraud probability for this transaction is 0.18, the transaction amount ($100.07) is close to the account's median spending ($117.01), and the cardholder's broader pattern shows 92 legitimate transactions across multiple channels and regions over five months. The device sharing with another account is a concern but does not definitively establish fraud on this single transaction. I concluded this transaction is legitimate with low confidence due to the account's fraud history and the new device signal, but the weak fraud probability and ordinary spending pattern do not support a fraud finding on the evidence presented.
